Subsequent calls forward the fighter and character/fixed feedback arguments exactly as shown in source.

facts.value: Unconditionally requests ftCo_MS_PassiveCeil with Ft_MF_None,0,1,0,NULL and performs ordered entry initialization; the routine has no local eligibility guard, timer or failure return. Its detector caller enforces ceiling contact and ftCo_800986B0. The active motion-state table associates PassiveCeil with its Anim, IASA, Phys and Coll callbacks. facts.value: Passes the Fighter to ftCheckThrowB3, which clears throw_flags_b3 when set. On success writes self_vel.x=input.lstick[0].x*co_attrs.passiveceil_vel_x. Independently queries ftAnim_IsFramesRemaining with the original game object and passes it to ftCo_Fall_Enter when the query is false.

facts.value: Consumes a pending throw_flags_b3 event to replace horizontal velocity with stick X times passiveceil_vel_x; without that event this callback leaves horizontal velocity unchanged. The assignment has no local clamp, dead zone, finite check or facing multiplier and is not continuous steering unless the flag is set again. The following independent animation-end branch may enter Fall on the same invocation, after the assignment. Other callbacks can also cause exits.

facts.value: Delegates to ft_800831CC with ftCo_80096CC8 and ft_80082B1C. The floor predicate rejects line -1, accepts non-platform lines, and accepts platforms only for stick Y > x25C (equality does not pass). The dispatcher selects collision queries using ledge cooldown/x2224_b2, synchronizes positions and lets ft_80081A00 veto floor response. Accepted response invokes ft_80082B1C immediately: self_vel.y > ftCo_800D0EC8(fp) selects ft_8008A2BC, otherwise basic landing. If the dispatcher's accepted-response path fails, wall-jump is attempted before ledge-grab. Callback pointers are not stored by this wrapper.

facts.value: Implements common-fighter ceiling-tech recovery: a ceiling-contact and eligibility detector initiates PassiveCeil, initializes position and effect/sound requests, and the active callback family supplies event-gated stick-scaled horizontal velocity, animation-completion Fall, no IASA-local work, and shared airborne physics/collision. The TU proves no local bound on the velocity product, precise event frame, invulnerability duration or exclusive Fall exit.

Animation completion enters Fall; delegated terrain responses can instead cause other exits. The source contains no explicit persistent local state or definitions proving .sdata2 layout.
